scope: Fresh held-out real Nemotron prefixes, independently reviewed by the coding agent using selected current words and prior context only, before classifier inference. This is AI-reviewed synthetic-speech evidence, not human ground truth or independent audio/interview accuracy certification. No future source text, source class or classifier scores were used to label prefixes. Ambiguous prefixes are excluded. All rows remain assessment-only; no fitting or threshold selection.

plan.selection: New episode groups are assessment-only. No epoch, temperature, threshold or policy selection from this data. Independent label review must finish before classifier evaluation.

audit.scope: Exact overlap audit, preserving identifier case and operators and normalizing whitespace only. New nonce-based group IDs alone do not establish semantic independence. Shared short words across different contexts are reported, not excluded; identical text/context pairs are excluded before classifier inference. No semantic novelty certification.

profileFrozenBeforeSourceGeneration.selection: New episode groups are assessment-only. No epoch, temperature, threshold or policy selection from this data. Independent label review must finish before classifier evaluation.
